description: Generic subset of the known-events knowledge base: Windows event signatures with a reviewed fix, root cause and priority. The production KB held 105 entries; environment-specific ones are omitted.

entries.suggestedFix: Get-ChildItem Env:COR_*,Env:CORECLR_* -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
entries.rootCauseAnalysis: Profiling API attach init fails; commonly from misconfigured APM agent or stale COR_PROFILER environment variables.

entries.suggestedFix: Report to AD team; DC certs must be reissued from Kerberos Authentication template (workstation cannot fix).
entries.rootCauseAnalysis: Domain Controller KDC certificate missing Kerberos Authentication EKU; resolution required on the DC, not the workstation.

entries.suggestedFix: sc.exe config Dhcp obj= 'NT AUTHORITY\LocalService' password= ''; Restart-Service Dhcp -Force
entries.rootCauseAnalysis: DHCP Client service cannot log on as LocalService due to corrupted secret store; cascades to WLAN dependency.

entries.suggestedFix: No action needed
entries.rootCauseAnalysis: Service stopped during system shutdown; expected behavior reported as an error code.

entries.suggestedFix: No action needed
entries.rootCauseAnalysis: Service stopped during system shutdown with service-specific shutdown code; expected, benign.

entries.suggestedFix: Restart-Service Appinfo
entries.rootCauseAnalysis: Application Information service (UAC) crashed once; isolated event tied to a specific elevation.

entries.suggestedFix: sc.exe config Dhcp obj= 'NT AUTHORITY\LocalService' password= ''; Restart-Service Dhcp -Force
entries.rootCauseAnalysis: Paired with SCM 7000; DHCP service password sync failure with NT Authority\LocalService account.

entries.suggestedFix: No action; extend preshutdown timeout only if shutdown is visibly delayed
entries.rootCauseAnalysis: Defender for Endpoint exceeded preshutdown control timeout; common, no functional impact.

entries.suggestedFix: Confirm-SecureBootUEFI; defer to next cumulative update which retries SBAT
entries.rootCauseAnalysis: Secure Boot SBAT revocation list update failed (0x800700c1); known Microsoft issue, retries on subsequent boots.

entries.suggestedFix: winmgmt /verifyrepository; Get-WmiObject -Namespace root\cimv2 -List | Out-Null
entries.rootCauseAnalysis: WMI provider host crashing with stack buffer overrun (0xc0000409); likely misbehaving WMI provider DLL.

entries.suggestedFix: lodctr /R
entries.rootCauseAnalysis: PerfLib tries to load SysMain (Superfetch) counter DLL but service is disabled on SSD systems; benign.

entries.suggestedFix: vssadmin resize shadowstorage /for=C: /on=C: /maxsize=20GB
entries.rootCauseAnalysis: VSS shadow copies aborted because allocated storage cap reached; restore points may be missing.

entries.suggestedFix: Restart-Computer (releases stuck hive handles); investigate AV/agent if recurring
entries.rootCauseAnalysis: User registry hive cannot unload at logoff due to lingering handle (often AV or background service).

entries.suggestedFix: No action; usually transient. Optional: Disable-NetAdapterBinding -Name * -ComponentID ms_netbios
entries.rootCauseAnalysis: NetBIOS over TCP/IP init failed; usually adapter ordering during boot; transient.

entries.suggestedFix: sfc /scannow; chkdsk C: /scan
entries.rootCauseAnalysis: Registry hive corrupted and auto-recovered; could indicate disk or specific licensing-store issue.

entries.suggestedFix: No action (shutdown race)
entries.rootCauseAnalysis: BITS service start attempt during shutdown (0x8007045B SHUTDOWN_IN_PROGRESS); benign race condition.

entries.suggestedFix: Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='System';ID=41;StartTime=(Get-Date).AddDays(-30)} -MaxEvents 10
entries.rootCauseAnalysis: System logged an unexpected shutdown; investigate for power loss, BSOD, or hard reset around that timestamp.

entries.suggestedFix: vssadmin list writers; retry the backup
entries.rootCauseAnalysis: VSS Registry Writer hit unloaded hive during freeze (0xc000014d); isolated snapshot failure.

entries.suggestedFix: Update the affected application to latest version
entries.rootCauseAnalysis: Application UI hung and was killed by Windows; isolated freeze, usually no recurring impact.

entries.suggestedFix: Get-ADUser <user> -Properties mail; populate mail attribute, OR have AD team modify cert template to not require email in Subject/SAN
entries.rootCauseAnalysis: Cert template requires email in Subject/SAN but the AD user object's mail attribute is empty (0x80094812).

entries.suggestedFix: Same as AutoEnrollment 6: populate AD user mail attribute or relax cert template email requirement
entries.rootCauseAnalysis: Paired with AutoEnrollment 6; CertEnroll cannot build cert subject because AD user lacks mail attribute (0x80094812).

entries.suggestedFix: Confirm-SecureBootUEFI; follow https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?linkid=2301018 to apply Secure Boot DBX/KEK update at next maintenance window
entries.rootCauseAnalysis: KB5025885 Secure Boot DBX/KEK rollout pending firmware apply; advisory until Microsoft enforces, no impact.

entries.suggestedFix: No action needed (Microsoft known cosmetic issue with PLA/logman.exe)
entries.rootCauseAnalysis: Performance Log and Alerts (logman.exe) running as SYSTEM denied DCOM access to RPCSS; documented MS cosmetic issue.

entries.suggestedFix: No action unless an application actually breaks; if it does, grant the named user the missing activation permission in Component Services for that AppID only.
entries.rootCauseAnalysis: A process asked for COM activation it has no permission for; Microsoft documents this as expected noise on most servers.
entries.exampleMessage: The application-specific permission settings do not grant Remote Launch permission for the COM Server application with CLSID {D99E6E74-FC88-11D0-B498-00A0C90312F3} and APPID {D99E6E74-FC88-11D0-B498-00A0C90312F3} to the user CONTOSO\svc

entries.suggestedFix: No action unless something needs remote COM+ activation; only then install the COM+ Network Access feature.
entries.rootCauseAnalysis: A remote COM+ activation request was refused because the COM+ Network Access feature is not installed; harmless unless something needs remote COM+.
entries.exampleMessage: The activation for CLSID {182C40F0-32E4-11D0-818B-00A0C9231C29} failed because remote activations for COM+ are disabled. To enable this functionality use Server Manager to install the COM+ Network Access feature in the Application Server role.
entries.messagePattern: remote activations for COM\+ are disabled

entries.suggestedFix: No action for a single occurrence; if it recurs, rebuild counters from an elevated prompt: lodctr /R (after backing up with lodctr /S:backup.ini).
entries.rootCauseAnalysis: The Server service performance counter provider failed to open, usually transient at startup or from damaged counter registration.
entries.exampleMessage: Unable to open the Server service performance object. The first four bytes (DWORD) of the Data section contains the status code.

entries.suggestedFix: Check the named service: Get-Service <name>; review its recovery options and the Application log around the crash; restart it if it is needed.
entries.rootCauseAnalysis: A service crashed and the Service Control Manager's automatic recovery action also failed, so the service may be stopped.
entries.exampleMessage: The Service Control Manager tried to take a corrective action (Restart the service) after the unexpected termination of the Microsoft Defender Antivirus Network Inspection Service service, but this action failed with the following error: An instance of the service is already running.

entries.suggestedFix: No action unless the counters are needed; if they are, rebuild with lodctr /R (elevated, after backing up with lodctr /S).
entries.rootCauseAnalysis: Windows could not load an extensible performance-counter DLL; the counters for that provider are missing, with no effect on the service itself.
entries.exampleMessage: Windows cannot load the extensible counter DLL InterceptCountersManager. The first four bytes (DWORD) of the Data section contains the Windows error code.
entries.observed: 2026-10-21 fleet mining (30d, 41 servers): 230 events on 8 server(s)
entries.messagePattern: cannot load the extensible counter DLL

entries.suggestedFix: No action. Slab consolidation cannot run on small-slab virtual disks; other storage-optimization failures are NOT covered by this entry.
entries.rootCauseAnalysis: Scheduled storage optimization skipped slab consolidation/analysis because the disk's slabs are under 8 MB (typical of virtual or thin disks); harmless.
entries.exampleMessage: The volume Windows (C:) was not optimized because an error was encountered: Neither Slab Consolidation nor Slab Analysis will run if slabs are less than 8 MB. (0x8900002D)
entries.observed: 2026-10-21 fleet mining: 42 events on 10 servers, across C:, D:, System Reserved, Recovery and data volumes (not only temporary storage)
entries.messagePattern: Neither Slab Consolidation nor Slab Analysis will run if slabs are less than 8 MB
